key_highlights: Aussie flash PMI plunges into contraction territory, signalling acute domestic economic slowdown.
Escalating Middle East geopolitical tensions trigger an oil price shock, compounding stagflation concerns.
Structural supply threats ('Pilbara killer') cloud iron ore outlook, weighing on major miners.
Accelerating home price declines and private credit stress raise risks for property developers and lenders.

sectors.trend: Iron ore margin squeeze from low-cost emerging supply paired with equity dilution across small-cap explorers.
sectors.implications: Earnings downgrades risk for pure-play bulk miners (FMG.AX); relative resilience in diversified miners (BHP.AX, RIO.AX).

sectors.trend: RBA policy uncertainty amid accelerating property price declines and developer credit distress.
sectors.implications: Margin compression, sluggish loan growth, and rising asset quality provisioning for major Australian banks.

sectors.trend: Oil price surges driven by Middle East geopolitical escalation and US-Iran conflict risks.
sectors.implications: Near-term earnings upside for domestic oil and gas producers (WDS.AX, STO.AX), despite broader economic headwinds.

sectors.trend: Private credit contraction squeezing developers alongside accelerating residential property value drops.
sectors.implications: Cap rate decompression, project cancellations, and heightened refinancing hurdles across property trusts.

sectors.trend: Household balance sheet squeeze and stark medium-term economic outlook dampening discretionary retail spending.
sectors.implications: Defensive discount retailers (WES.AX) outperform discretionary operators and gaming names facing regulatory fines (SGR.AX).

key_themes: Domestic growth shock reflected in sub-50 flash PMI and AUD volatility
Iron ore long-term price reset driven by emerging West African supply
Credit crunch in private non-bank development financing
Geopolitical oil shocks driving cost-push inflation and complicating RBA monetary policy

risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight cyclical domestic exposures; increase cash allocations and high-quality liquid short-term paper.
Reduce pure-play iron ore exposure (FMG.AX); diversify into base metals and global copper exposure.
Avoid high-leverage property developers; restrict REIT exposure to premium industrial logistics with high occupancy.
Tactically overweight upstream energy producers (WDS.AX, STO.AX) as portfolio inflation hedge.

opportunities.recommendation: Long upstream oil and gas producers
opportunities.rationale: Geopolitical supply shocks and rising crude prices generate strong near-term free cash flow.

opportunities.recommendation: Accumulate diversified mining majors with copper upside
opportunities.rationale: Strong balance sheets buffer against iron ore softening while capturing energy transition demand.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim major bank holdings and reduce exposure to housing-sensitive financials
defensive_moves.rationale: Accelerating property price declines and credit distress threaten NIM expansion and credit quality.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge ASX 200 exposure and overweight consumer staples
defensive_moves.rationale: Flash PMI contraction and weak growth outlook warrant defensive positioning in non-cyclical retail.

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish to rangebound for the ASX 200 (^AXJO) over 1–3 months, pressured by PMI contraction, property weakness, and commodity drag.
market_outlook.long_term: Neutral for 6–12 months, with sustainable equity recovery contingent on RBA rate clarity and Chinese demand stabilization.
key_catalysts: RBA interest rate decision and revised monetary policy statement
Quarterly CPI inflation print tracking domestic services stickiness
Developments in Middle East conflict impacting crude shipping and price stability
Seaborne iron ore volume updates from Simandou and Brazilian supply routes
watch_list: Australian Flash Manufacturing and Services PMI
AUD/USD exchange rate movements amid growth shock
CoreLogic dwelling value indices across major capitals
Brent crude oil spot and futures forward curve
